name: Yar

facts.text: Yar is a level-73 named with 40,000 health in the southwest of Malmohus (region 100 at 695353, 1022775).
At 30% health he calls drakulv executioners, soultrappers and disciples to his aid.
The quest 'Yar the Firstborn' (from Kiaja at Svarhamr) calls him the oldest and strongest of the drakulv, the most powerful of the werewolves, and says to bring an adequate force.
A Dec 2002 Allakhazam comment says killing Yar reduces the chance of Gjalpinulva's exhale (unverified hearsay); a 2003 comment says one good crowd-control group can do him.
Swedish drake means dragon and ulv wolf (the compound 'drakulv' to verify).

story: Yar was the first. Before the drakulv were a people, before there were armguards and axehands and soultrappers and priests, there was one pup in the ruins with scales on its back and a wolf's grin, and Gjalpinulva licked the frost off it and named it. He is the oldest of her brood and the strongest, and he hunts the southwest of Malmohus with his kin. When he is hurt badly he howls, and the drakulv come running: executioners, soultrappers and disciples, because the firstborn has never once called and not been answered. The svartalfar of Svarhamr pay well for his head. They say his mother feels it when he dies.
legend: Yar's a group fight with good crowd control. At 30% he shouts and his kin come, so have mez ready and save power. Raid leaders used to kill Yar on the way to the dragon because they swore it made her breathe less. Nobody ever proved it. His head makes a fine wall trophy.

aggro: Firstborn of the Wolf's Daughter! You are in my mother's ruins!

lairEntry: Old claw-marks scar the stones. The firstborn hunts here.
